articles.title: Trump hid in catering truck in secret plane swap over Iran threat, reports say
articles.description: The US president was moved from the old Air Force One to a military plane as he left a Nato summit in Turkey last month, US media say.

articles.title: Amber Met Office extreme heat warning issued as temperatures could reach 38C
articles.description: An amber weather warning for extreme heat has been issued for Thursday, when extreme temperatures are expected to peak.

articles.title: Councils to get more powers to stop vape and betting shops, PM announces
articles.description: Prime Minister Andy Burnham said town centres had been "hollowed out" by decades of decline.

articles.title: Russia using North Korean missiles to strike Ukraine, Zelensky says
articles.description: Ukraine's president says strikes in Zaporizhzhia - which killed at least six and injured 19 - involved ballistic missiles from Russia's ally.
